reply: Fixed in 8b24342c56c3a73a9caf5dda70074c5cc513e6b9, the initializer now builds one WtaMeta containing the cloud catalog, resolved identity, and proposal capability, then injects that namespace only once.

Fixed in a28fefaca6a328a495fef0071956da8a005a5aac, Removed WTA-owned per-session /yolo controls and the SetSessionYolo flow, eliminating the fallback opt-in/opt-out path that could leave a local override enabled.

Fixed in d6802724564cd781866cd731c630ea3e95a54c54, the client now records the post-RPC Yolo target, and SessionAttached compares it with the latest effective state and reconciles any mismatch, closing the settings/policy update race.

Fixed in 7c8a682224b1a0750834c76b77783bfd30133788, centralized per-session cleanup and called it from /new, drop_tab_session, and reset_tab_session_for, removing both the Yolo override and pending change before session IDs can be reused.

Fixed in e3cec54da0989efcdc060d46de46fab0453339f7, translated commands.yolo.summary in the German and every other non-English WTA locale catalog, replacing the copied English text while preserving the required technical tokens.
Fixed in e3cec54da0989efcdc060d46de46fab0453339f7, the en-US locked-token annotation now lists only ACP, Yolo, and /new, removing the absent /yolo token.

Fixed in e3cec54da0989efcdc060d46de46fab0453339f7, translated commands.yolo.summary in every non-English WTA locale catalog and corrected the locked-token annotations, eliminating the copied English summary.

Fixed in e3cec54da0989efcdc060d46de46fab0453339f7, the live Copilot tests now probe ACP readiness, classify authentication failures as installed-unauthenticated, and skip those environments instead of waiting for agent readiness.

Fixed in a28fefaca6a328a495fef0071956da8a005a5aac, Removed the provider-native Yolo real-tool matrix and its executable-only provider gate, so unauthenticated Claude, Codex, or Gemini can no longer enter that readiness path.
